purpose: Strengthen the real (u,t) quadratic relaxation by retaining the integer/nonnegative split structure already present in the FULL178 exceptional multiplicities, without enumerating terminals and without duplicating MAIN's LP allocation.

mathematics.exact_three_split_minimum: min_{r+s+v=a, nonnegative integers}(r^2+s^2+v^2)=qmin3(a); 6*qmin3(a)=2*a^2 + (0 if a=0 mod 3 else 4)
mathematics.fast_u_minimizer: For fixed (b,c,t), the exact integer relaxed minimum is attained among floor(u0),ceil(u0) clipped to the integer feasible interval. If u0 is outside, the nearest integer boundary suffices. Thus the u search is at most two candidates.
mathematics.strength_relation: The resulting integer-lattice GRF04 lower bound is globally >= the real quadratic lower bound because it minimizes a pointwise stronger objective over a smaller integer/nonnegative domain. Therefore failure of the integer-lattice condition safely excludes every completion excluded by the real relaxation and potentially more.

main_candidate_comparison.relation: MAIN drops integrality/nonnegativity in the (u,t) minimization. This 178 kernel keeps those constraints at the lower-bound stage and also replaces a^2/3 by the exact integer three-split minimum. It does not rerun or claim MAIN's LP certificate.

next_route.goal: Replace the MAIN real quadratic lower bound by this integer-lattice lower bound inside a 178-owned compressed capacity census, using the at-most-two-u-candidate kernel and a cached t minimization. First run a bounded exact regression against the retained TD02 terminal/source census; only then consider FULL178 scaleout.
